model_annotation: The plot illustrates coverage as a function of the number of completions (k). The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", uses a logarithmic scale and ranges from approximately 20 to 28, with tick intervals spaced by one unit. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", ranges from approximately 0.68 to 0.83 and utilizes a linear scale. A solid blue line with diamond markers represents Llama-3B, starting at a coverage value of approximately 0.68 at k=20 and increasing to a coverage value of approximately 0.83 at k=28. A dashed cyan line with square markers represents Llama-3B + FT, beginning at a coverage value of approximately 0.42 at k=20 and reaching a coverage of approximately 0.66 at k=28. A solid light blue line with triangle markers represents Llama-1B, initiating at a coverage of approximately 0.40 at k=20 and culminating at a coverage of approximately 0.63 at k=28. Finally, a dashed light green line with diamond markers represents Llama-1B + FT, starting at approximately 0.33 at k=20 and attaining a coverage value of approximately 0.57 at k=28.
